gloss: to confront; to face; to stand up against

definitions.gloss: to confront; to face; to oppose
definitions.explanation: To bravely face a difficulty, challenge, or opponent rather than avoiding it. Implies courage and determination.

examples.english: To stand up against the enemy.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう{勇気|ゆうき}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need the courage to face problems.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}で{大企業|だいきぎょう}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かうのは{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: It's hard to stand up against a large corporation alone.

examples.japanese: {不正|ふせい}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かった{記者|きしゃ}が{賞|しょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The journalist who stood up against corruption received an award.

examples.japanese: どんなに{厳|きび}しい{状況|じょうきょう}でも、{彼女|かのじょ}は{逃|に}げずに{立|た}ち{向|む}かった。
examples.english: No matter how tough the situation, she faced it head-on without running away.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{立|た}ち{向|む}かう → {立|た}ち{向|む}かわない (negative)
・{立|た}ち{向|む}かう → {立|た}ち{向|む}かって (te-form)
・{立|た}ち{向|む}かう → {立|た}ち{向|む}かった (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {立|た}つ (to stand) + {向|む}かう (to face toward)

The compound emphasizes taking a strong stance and actively confronting something.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{困難|こんなん}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to face difficulties
・{敵|てき}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to stand up against an enemy
・{運命|うんめい}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to confront fate
・{問題|もんだい}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to tackle a problem
・{逆境|ぎゃっきょう}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to face adversity

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{挑|いど}む - to challenge (more aggressive)
・{対峙|たいじ}する - to confront (more formal)
・{向|む}き{合|あ}う - to face (more neutral)
